decision_criteria.LINEAR_Q_SIGNAL_PRESENT_IN_ENCODER: YES requires median out-of-fold probe AUC >=0.65, median out-of-fold R2 >0, and at least 10/16 heads with probe AUC >=0.65.
decision_criteria.COMMON_MODE_THRESHOLD_MISCALIBRATION: YES requires median production AUC >=0.65, median current sign accuracy <=0.60, median threshold-only accuracy gain >=0.10, and gain >=0.10 in at least 10/16 heads.
decision_criteria.OPERATION_WEIGHT_DIRECTION_MISALIGNED: YES requires linear signal present, median probe-minus-production AUC >=0.10, AUC gain >=0.10 in at least 10/16 heads, and median |actual-vs-probe cosine| <=0.30.
decision_criteria.ENCODER_LINEAR_Q_SIGNAL_INSUFFICIENT: YES requires median out-of-fold probe AUC <=0.60, median out-of-fold R2 <=0, and fewer than 8/16 heads with probe AUC >=0.65.

protocol.outer_cv: leave-one-realization-out 4-fold; 24 train and 8 test samples per fold
protocol.inner_alpha_selection: nested realization-held-out MSE within each outer training fold
protocol.feature_centering: Outer and inner train-fold means only; held-out realization never contributes to centering or alpha selection.
protocol.threshold_selection: Maximize training-fold sign accuracy without changing score ordering; ties choose threshold closest to current production threshold.
protocol.checkpoint_reads: cache_trigger_head weights/bias only; SHA256 checked against input report
